verdict.rationale: Simular's docs describe one of its own offerings, an agent framework for controlling computers, as open-source. The flagship Sai product (API, MCP server, desktop and cloud computers) is never described as open source. No license or repository is named. Missing for 10: a named open license, a link to a public source repository, evidence that Sai's own source (not just the framework) is readable, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: An open-source framework for agents that control computers like a human — UI, keyboard, and mouse — across environments.
